about_the_game:
Select available color character cubic, and then fight other cubics with other color than you've selected. Buy weapons like sword, elemental magic staff, gun, missile launcher, or other available weapons, recruit more ally and set their strategy, and/or upgrade your stuffs to help you to fight your enemies, but make sure you have the money for those things, while also save some money (if you wanted to) so that you'll get money bonus based on interest rates after the next battle is finished.

Different Weapons and Different Ammo Type

Each weapon has its own ammo type, which can either Unlimited, Limited, Mana, or Energy.

Different Difficulty Means Different Total Waves

First difficulty contains a total of 30 waves (including challenge missions/waves). Harder difficulties with more waves becomes available after you clear the first difficulty. Clearing each difficulty will also unlock things like more available weapons and more available color character cubic to be selected.

Challenge Mission/Waves

Every main stage has 1 wave that has its mission is different than usual.

Manage Money Carefully

Plan your money use carefully. You can spent a lot of money to strengthen your team each wave, but without any saving, upgrading bounty, or etc, may lead you to struggle in later waves.

Credits

  • In game Credits on the main menu can be unlocked once the first difficulty is cleared.

  • Trailer music: Drum Or Bass - Ryan Stasik by BASSLOOM

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Tested on old family PC (broken CPU fan port) with OS Windows 10, CPU Intel Core i7-3770, RAM DDR3 8GB, GPU AMD Radeon HD 5450, game installed on HDD, graphic setting medium. Result: game is laggy but kinda still playable up to stage 2-1, with total RAM used between 3.9GB and 4GB, CPU Load about 10-18%, GPU Load unknown.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 6700HQ or AMD Ryzen 7 3750H or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 950M / AMD Radeon Radeon R7 M375 or higher
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: With this specs, the game should be playable smoothly, even if the game is installed on HDD and graphic setting is set on High.
